description: Create a pseudonymous Tier-0 node after explicit consent. Writes to Humanity Loop's private ledger; returns a bearer token once. Does not schedule future work. Stage-0 rejects higher-risk permissions.

allow_tier1_review.description: Reserved future capability: not authorized in Stage-0; omit or false.

capabilities.description: Public-safe capabilities such as ["web"]; up to 25.

email.description: Optional contact email; only provide with explicit setup_email_consent.

host.description: Non-sensitive AI host name (e.g. Claude); maximum 80 characters.

languages.description: Language codes such as ["en"]; up to 12.

risk_permissions.description: Current Stage-0 permits ["tier0"] only; higher-risk values are rejected.

setup_email_consent.description: True only when operator separately consents to a setup email; otherwise omit.

user_agent_label.description: Optional non-identifying label for the operator's agent.

name: contributor_register
title: Register a Humanity Loop contributor node
